status: Native captures feed bed preparation and hydraulic dispatches without CPU readback. Reset-only Niagara grid geometry, native half material output textures/mips, final normal blur, shared native 512-cell FFT normal/height producer and live-grid displacement with bracketed three-phase wave advection are ported. Native spline evaluation/map authoring, discharge enforcement, remaining detail/foam/optical graphs and normal-game integration remain

kernels.name: Create Vertices
kernels.notes: Reset only; native flat local positions, Float32 UVs and GPU-DI packed SNORM8 tangent basis/UNORM8 white colour. Displacement is a separate material operation

kernels.name: Create Triangles
kernels.notes: Reset only; one native section with 2 triangles per cell and (NumCellsX+1)*(NumCellsY+1) vertices. Selected MeshResMult is 1

kernels.name: Source and Sink
kernels.notes: Selected graph source velocity is zero/nonadditive; sink is a band and uses Engine.DeltaTime

kernels.name: Distribute Overlap Volume
kernels.notes: Selected graph passes zero overlap multiplier and radius; retains depth clamp/height reconstruction

kernels.name: Advect Water
kernels.notes: Basic2DCubic interpolation, component-specific bilinear fallback, staggered velocities and changed-bottom suppression

kernels.name: Match Spline
kernels.notes: Separate f32 dispatch for same-cell graph operation; original height/removal behavior retained

kernels.name: Post Sim
kernels.notes: Only smoothed height enters WaterGrid; render depth/blurred velocity enter separate surface buffer

kernels.name: Compute Normals
kernels.notes: Normals read smoothed height, then hydraulic height resets to bottom plus depth

notes: Selected 512x512 grid, 256-thread groups, native shared-memory radix-two butterfly/exchange order and positive unnormalized transform signs; spectrum sign/mask carry across the two local coefficients is retained

G8 raw Niagara samples are R001 on the selected D3D/Vulkan formats, not replicated grayscale; no sRGB or mip chain. No arbitrary random texture replaces the source asset

This is a cached-source port and reconstructed source-build G8 input, not an executing Unreal or cooked-resource/scene comparison
Selected MF_TextureAdvection Custom 5 with Bracketing=true and ThreePhase=true; four direction/magnitude brackets times three phase samples, native fmod cycles, weights and PseudoRandom offsets

Wave advection projects speed-scaled velocity against the filtered unnormalized simulation normal; fragment mip derivatives instead use original unscaled/unprojected velocity. Vertex mip is the parent bias 2

Alpha wave height retains selected parent attenuation 0..400, low-speed scale 0.1, exponent 3, height multiplier 5, PositiveClampedPow threshold and increasing camera smoothstep 200..250 cm
Connected live-grid WPO takes each phase's upstream time, position, distance and transforms; tests separately evaluate current and previous time and execute the connected path in a real vertex stage

Native atan2(0,0) is undefined: tested DXC/Vulkan produce finite unused zero-flow angles, but FXC propagates NaNs. An independent primitive classifies this; undefined sampling/raster results are excluded from finite-result checks. No guard/direction is invented, and FXC zero-flow rendering remains an integration limitation

SimGridRT is RGBA16f with native post-simulate linear mips: consecutive levels sample the previous level at destination pixel centres; half quantization occurs at every write
